Hi,
I have not received any information or updates from DHL regarding the shipment.
As previously stated, I will keep the PayPal dispute open until the refund is processed. You can easily issue the refund directly through the PayPal dispute page right now. Once you process the refund via PayPal, the case will automatically close.
Please issue the refund through PayPal so we can resolve this matter.
Best regards,
Jörg
Handed to the team · Refund on a disputed order: only Georges or Abel can issue it, and it has to be

Hi Jörg,

Thank you for checking with DHL, and for telling me there has been nothing from them. I have noted that the original tracking, (phone hidden), closed on October 22 without delivery, and the unit has not been checked in at our warehouse.

On the refund: that is handled by a colleague, not by me, so I have put your request in front of them with your note that it should go through the PayPal case so it closes on its own. They are offline over the weekend and will pick this up on Monday from 10am Eastern, and you will get their confirmation by email in this same thread, so there is nothing further you need to send.

Sorry for how long this one has dragged on, and thank you for your patience with it.

Best regards,
Sarah

Hello Heliumdeploy team,

 I have still not received a refund from you. As I do not wish to invest any more time in this issue, I would ask that you finally initiate the refund.

Best regards, Jörg S.
Handed to the team · Refund still not issued since the last flag; customer is chasing. Disputed order

Hello Jörg,

Understood, and I am sorry you have had to ask again.

The refund is not something I can release myself, so I have put it straight in front of Georges and Abel with your request that it be issued on the PayPal side so the case closes on its own. They are at their desks now and are picking it up today. You will get their confirmation as a reply in this thread, with the amount, so you do not need to send anything further.

Thank you for your patience with this one.

Best regards,
Sarah
